values.$comment: present only answering a kind=form request (AEP-0006): flat map of field_spec.id -> answer. Per-key gating is type-dependent and cannot be expressed schema-mechanically (it depends on the referenced field_spec.type): a string-typed field's value, and an `other` free-text value on a select field, follow answer.text's rule (redacted minimum, never metadata); number/boolean/closed-select values are structural and stay metadata. Enforced by emitters and `aep validate`, plus the conformance/fixtures/capture-gating/ corpus
